name: Luque Law
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 >/dev/null; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; node -v; npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; npm run dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server (Turbopack) on http://localhost:3000. Runs under Node 24 (required by package.json engines and eve).
